title: Your reskilling pathway
progressBody: Tick courses as you finish them. Each badge shows how its courses are evidenced: self-reported, certificate link, or confirmed by your organisation. Badges are not an assessment.
estimateNote: Weeks and the level each course brings you to are estimates.
catalogueOnly: Courses come only from our catalogue, each with its source and the date we checked it.

summary.title: Plan summary
summary.outOfPocket: You pay RM {amount} of your RM {budget} budget
summary.hrdNote: HRD Corp-claimable courses may be funded if your employer applies for the levy grant before the course starts. The cost above is the list price until that is approved.

style.classroom: Classroom learning style: in-person, live online or hybrid courses are chosen first when they fit your budget.
style.video: Video learning style: self-paced online courses are chosen first.
style.reading: Reading learning style: self-paced online courses are chosen first.

unmet.title: Skills you build at work
unmet.over_budget: Courses cost more than your budget
unmet.catalogue_tops_out: Courses cover the basics; real work builds the rest

plan.save: Choose this role and save the plan
plan.decide: You decide. Saving commits you to nothing, and you can change it any time.
plan.sdgLink: How this path contributes to the SDGs

progress.noBadges: No badges yet. Finish a course to earn your first.

saved: Saved. Your progress and badges are updated.

catalogue.title: Course catalogue
catalogue.description: Every course Adept may recommend: free and paid, online and in person, with HRD Corp status, price basis, source and the date we checked it.

evidence.hint: Ticking a course is self-reported. A certificate link shows the course page exists, not that you have the skill; your HR or career advisor can confirm it.
evidence.sent: Link saved. We only checked that it opens on the provider's site; a reviewer confirms whether it is yours.

link.provider_verified: submitted for review; learner and course not verified
link.not_provider_page: not an official verification page: needs a manual check
link.submitted: submitted for review; learner and course not verified

verify.title: Review course completions
verify.description: Confirm or reject completions reported by members of your organisation. Learners see your decision and note.
verify.hrdHint: For HRD Corp-claimable courses, the provider's attendance record in your HRD Corp claim is the proof to check against.
verify.checkName: check that the name and course match

compare.title: Compare roles before you choose
compare.description: What each future role would take for you: time, cost, skills to close, its trend outlook and SDG links. You decide; nothing is chosen for you.
compare.coverage: Trend data covers {percent}% of this role's skills; the rest count as neutral.
compare.humanInCharge: This comparison supports your decision; it does not rank or select roles for you.
compare.emptyHint: Return to matches to choose a target role.

history.title: Completed learning history
history.description: Completed courses stay here when your target or remaining plan changes. You can review the evidence or undo a completion.
